_hinweis: Prompts für die Grafiken unter assets/art/. Die Bilder wurden am 2026-10-03 über OpenRouter mit google/gemini-3.1-flash-image erzeugt (Stil-Präfix + Motiv), danach zugeschnitten, verkleinert und als WebP gespeichert (Wappen mit freigestelltem Kreis). Neu erzeugte Bilder ersetzen die WebP-Datei gleichen Namens.
stil: Children's picture-book vector illustration. Bold dark brown ink outlines (#3b2614), flat colors, limited warm palette: sand #c8965f, cream #efd6ab, orange #e07a1f, soft pink #d9568a, sage green #8fae7a, pale sky blue #cfe6ef. Simple, calm, friendly. No text, no letters, no numbers.

header.webp.prompt: Wide banner. A sunny savanna with soft sand dunes, an acacia tree and a few cacti; a family of three friendly meerkats standing upright on a dune, the middle one wearing a small red party hat, next to an open school exercise notebook with grid paper and a pencil. Lots of empty sky.

klasse-erdmaennchen.webp.prompt: Round badge emblem. Head and shoulders of a cute meerkat wearing a small red party hat, inside a circular cream badge with a thin dotted orange ring. Transparent background.

klasse-hasen.webp.prompt: Round badge emblem. Head and shoulders of a cute light grey bunny holding a small carrot, inside a circular pale pink badge with a thin dotted pink ring. Transparent background.

karte-wache.webp.prompt: Game card picture. A meerkat standing upright on a small sand hill at sunrise, stretching and yawning next to its burrow, with four little white clouds in the sky each carrying one math symbol: plus, minus, a dot for times, a colon for divide.

ende.webp.prompt: Celebration scene on a bright morning in the savanna. A happy, wide-awake group of five meerkats on a sand dune, the middle one wearing a red party hat with a golden rosette ribbon above it, confetti and small stars in a clear light-blue sky, the sun standing high.

../icons/icon.svg.prompt: App icon, square, full-bleed background with no border. A single friendly meerkat standing upright and smiling, in front of a big yellow rising sun with short rays, on a gentle sand hill. Sky fades from pale blue to warm peach. Keep the meerkat and sun inside the central 80% so the icon can be cropped to a circle. Afterwards render PNGs in 512, 192, 180 and 32 px (icon-512.png, icon-192.png, apple-touch-icon.png, favicon-32.png).
